snippet.title: COD4 Frontlines R3L04D - The Definitive Version
snippet.description:
Play @ cod4.bloodculture.com.br every sunday @ 20h GMT-3
Just click in the Frontlines menu JOIN GLOBAL WAR SERVER

COD4 Frontlines R3L04D | Hajas Mods | http://www.mods.hajas.org

Short film about the Definitive Version Frontlines R3L04D mod for Call of Duty 4 : Modern Warfare which transform your COD4 into the most diverse and complete FPS ever made, with 42 gametypes, over 2400 Weapons Modes, Help Mode and lots and lots of features NEVER done before. 

Some of these features were already copied by MW2, Black Ops and Bad Company 2. More info and download @ www.mods.hajas.org
